indicator_name: Monetary survey of the National Bank of Kazakhstan, history from 1997 (NBK page records)
description: Монетарный обзор Национального Банка РК (история с 1997 г., данные страницы НБК)
unit: million KZT, stock at the end of the previous month (as at the date)
methodology: NBK page «Монетарный обзор НБК» (records JSON), stock at the end of each month from 1997-12, dated the first day of the next month (as at, like form 50): the year-month of reporting_date is the month-end, its day and published_at are noise. Item CB.<NBK key>, Russian label from the page. Equals form 50 (NBK_MONETARY_SURVEY) lines 1, 2.1, 2.3-2.6, 3, 3.1, 3.1.1 on all 44 common dates 2023-01..2026-08 within 0.9 mln (enforced). Quasi-fiscal line CB.n_d_a_r_non_banking = NBK claims on non-bank financial organisations (KSF, Problem Loans Fund; mostly equity: 5.09 of 5.32 trn at 2021-12): 146 208 mln at 2012-01-01 (end-2011), 1 230 126 (2018-01-01), 3 044 011 (2020-01-01), 5 317 553 (2022-01-01), 5 137 668 (2026-09-01). CB.n_d_a_r_rest_economy steps from 59 711 to 821 820 at 2015-07-01 (read as a ~750 bn NBK equity claim on public nonfinancial corporations; not named by the NBK). Identities enforced: n_i_r, n_e_a, net claims on government, l = n_e_a + n_d_a, l = liabilities, r_m = its parts; n_d_a = its published lines only through 2009-02-01 (from 2009-03-01 an unpublished line of 0.6-6.7 trn, as in form 50 line 2). Items «Минус: …» are positive numbers subtracted.
